meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成或编辑照片、插画等视觉素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为文章或项目快速生成配图，又不想学笨重的设计软件。
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit photos, illustrations, and visual assets with AI models.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need visual assets and don't want to use complicated design software.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调用脚本，按你的描述用 OpenRouter 图像模型生成图片；也可以传入已有图片做修改，结果保存为 PNG 文件。使用前需要配置 OpenRouter API key。
howto.when: 当你要求生成或编辑照片、插画、概念图等普通图像时触发；流程图、电路图等技术示意图应改用 scientific-schematics 技能。

say.text: 生成一张夕阳下的山脉图片，保存为 sunset.png
say.note: 脚本生成图片并存成 PNG

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs the script to generate an image from your prompt with OpenRouter image models, or edit an existing image passed via --input, saving the result as a PNG. An OpenRouter API key must be configured first.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask for photos, illustrations, concept art, or other general images. For flowcharts, circuits, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

say_en.text: Generate an image of mountains at sunset, save as sunset.png
say_en.note: Script saves the image as a PNG

say_en.text: Change the background of photo.jpg to blue
Generate a cat in space with the flux.2-pro model
